_comment: CFG-6: a full-length novel. Thirty-four chapters through a four-critic gate: read the call count in the orchestrator plan before you start it.
_comment_bible: How much canon a book this size can carry. 34 chapters. The base counts are too SMALL here, not too large. Every profile states these now: inheriting one set of counts for every length is how a three-chapter run and a thirty-four-chapter novel ended up with the same Story Bible.
